title: A no-charge line adds no tax and nothing owed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location charges a 5% tax on labor.
  • Open Reports > Sales Tax Collected and Reports > A/R Aging Summary for today and note the totals.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today, billable, invoiced after the totals were noted and left unpaid, with line 1 of 2.0 hours ($240.00) and line 2 of 1.5 hours No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Sales Tax Collected.
  2. Open Reports > A/R Aging Summary.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Taxable sales are the noted figure plus $240.00 and tax collected the noted figure plus $12.00: line 2 adds $0.00.

Step 2:

  • Customer A owes $252.00 ($240.00 + $12.00): line 2 adds nothing owed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports)

  • S9-R12: “Work In Progress keeps its existing treatment of a $0 line (quoted hours, no value); an open internal or no-charge work order shows with its badge as S9-R9 says. Sales Tax Collected, IBS Batches, the A/R Aging reports, customer statements, Inventory Value and the A/P reports are not affected by a no-charge line: it adds $0.00 taxable and nothing owed.”
